import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Find 4-connected components of each nonzero color.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==col:
                            seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
                comps.append((col,cells))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for col,cells in comps:
        r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
        c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
        # Push each figure to the nearest horizontal edge, retaining its column.
        top=sum(y for y,x in cells)/len(cells) < h/2
        nr=0 if top else h-1-(r1-r0)
        for y,x in cells: out[nr+y-r0][x]=col
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
print('written')
